review_notes: This page carries no printed page number, no running header and no table title — the column-header row is the first thing on the page. printed_page 422 is inferred from printed_page = scan − 3.

The columns are NOT the feast columns assumed in the brief; they are the ዓመተ ምሕረት cycle table. The feast columns (ዐቢይ ጾም … ትንሣኤ) are on scan 426 and the post-Easter feasts on scan 427: all three pages are the SAME 15-row table split across three pages, row for row (row 1 = ፪ሺ፩ on every page).
The third column header reads ባሕት as printed; its values are weekday names (the weekday of መስከረም ፩).

Cells resolved by internal consistency rather than by glyph alone (the ፬/፭/፮/፯ glyphs are near-identical at this scan quality): row 3 መባጃ ሐመር ፲፮ and row 4 ፲፯ (that column runs 14,15,16,17,18,19,1,2,…,9); row 7 ጾመ ነነዌ ጥር ፳፭ and row 13 የካ ፲፭ (both confirmed by the ዐቢይ ጾም column on scan 426, which is exactly 14 days later); and the last row's year ፪ሺ፲፭ (its final digit could be read ፭ or ፮, but its ወንጌላዊ/ባሕት/አበቅቴ values all match 2015 ዓ.ም).
